UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's core profile information and references to their personalized settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

role.description: The user's role within the application (e.g., 'standard', 'admin').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the user's last activity.

defaultUserPreferenceId.description: Reference to the UserPreference entity representing the user's default preferences.

Insight.title: Insight
Insight.description: Represents a market insight shared by a user in the social stream.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity who created this insight.

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

symbols.description: List of market symbols linked to this insight.

isLive.description: Whether the insight was shared during a live broadcast.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the insight was created.

attachment.description: Optional chart mapping associated with the insight.

CommunityMessage.title: CommunityMessage
CommunityMessage.description: A real-time message within a specific community hub or sector.

FeedbackItem.title: FeedbackItem
FeedbackItem.description: Stores user-submitted feedback or bug reports.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores core profile information for each user. Access is restricted to the owning user.

/insights/{insightId}.description: Public stream of market insights. Any authenticated user can read; only the owner can write/delete.

/communities/{hubId}/messages/{messageId.description: Independent real-time chat room messages for a specific hub or sector.
